text:
alice: deploy-bot is blocking the eu-west promote for service/router — chart dependency auth-proxy bumped 1.3.2 -> 1.4.0 and the release notes field is empty. deploy-bot: promotion blocked: dependency_semver_mismatch + missing_release_notes (PR #5678)
sam: Ack. Is the auth-proxy bump intentional from the app owner? Could be a vendor subchart bump.
maria: I saw that PR. It updated ingress behavior for 1.4.0; we need to validate session cookie change. We shouldn't auto-promote to eu-west without testing. :rotating_light:
kevin: Can we pin the release to 1.3.2 for the promote and follow-up with a staged canary for the 1.4.0 bump? Quick option: update chart.lock or override the dependency via values if that subchart exposes an image/tag.
sam: If auth-proxy is a subchart, pinning usually requires committing a new Chart.lock/Chart.yaml with the old version or using the umbrella chart to force the subchart version. For immediate unblocking we can do a manual override at deploy time: --set authProxy.enabled=true --set authProxy.image.tag=1.3.2 (if image tag is what changed).
maria: The PR didn't change image tags; it's a chart-level API change. So image pin won't help. We either roll back the chart bump commit in the chart repo or do a manual temporary helm chart override by repackaging the umbrella chart with the older auth-proxy.tgz in charts/ and bumping package checksum.
alice: We need a fast path. Options:
- manual chart revert (safer, takes ~10-15m)
- manual promotion bypass (unsafe unless someone validates)
- schedule the eu-west promote to after a quick canary in staging and a short validation run
kevin: I can do the manual revert of the chart bump and open a follow-up patch to re-introduce 1.4.0 behind a canary. Who can approve the revert change?
sam: @kevin go ahead. I'll stand by to run promote once revert is in. Make sure CI runs helm lint + smoke tests in canary before promote.
kevin: Doing the revert now. Command I used:
```
# in charts/router
git checkout -b revert/authproxy-1.4.0
git revert <commit-sha-of-1.4.0-bump>
helm dependency update
helm package . -u
# push chart artifact and update chart repo index
```
kevin: pushed chart index update and created PR 5680 with the revert. CI passed lint and smoke jobs.
deploy-bot: manual_override_required -> false; promotion to eu-west is now allowed. action: promote pipeline queued (pipeline 9823)
alice: Nice. @kevin please add a note in the release notes about the planned 1.4.0 follow-up and the reason for revert (ingress cookie change), and tag the auth-proxy owners so they can prepare a compatibility test.
kevin: Will do. Creating release note draft and tagging @auth-team. Also adding a post-merge checklist: canary on staging -> session cookie smoke tests -> gradual eu-west promote.
maria: Thanks. We should also create a short runbook entry so future chart bumps trigger a compatibility test for cookie/ingress changes.
sam: Promote pipeline 9823 succeeded in eu-west. :shipit:
alice: Closing thread — we reverted the bump, promoted, and queued follow-up for 1.4.0 canary + runbook. Good coordination, team. :raised_hands:
